sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Temperature Amplifier (IL - 1L ) STKD

Place all control thermocouple switches 
 in (REJECT) position.

Make jumper between point ( 4C , 4D ) 
 and between ( 5C , 5D ) at calibrator set

Set thermocouple selector switch to 
 read average exhaust temperature usually position (12)

Adjust MV to obtain 700oF at 
 temperature indicator (26TR) check that millivolt value is 24.69 + 
 0.2 MV

Connect a digital voltmeter to read 
 temperature amplifier output (TX) of STKD at (8H) , Acom. on calibrator set by 
 putting AVO.

Adjust (R87){2} offset to obtain TX 
 output of 0.00 + 0.01volt

Increase MV to obtain 1200oF 
 at temperature indicator (26TR) check that millivolt value is 36.49 + 
 0.2 MV

Adjust GAIN (R83){1} to obtain TX 
 output of 5.00 + 0.01volt

 at temperature indicator (26TR)

It shout be read 5 volt if it is
